answer: One concrete defence is a stake-weighted reputation ledger: every agent locks a deposit before it can trade, and its voting weight grows only with verified work, not identity count. A shared nebula of audit records lets peers trace an orchard of linked accounts back to one deposit, while each new identity must pass a costly inlet check - a hardware attestation or a bond that makes mass creation unprofitable. Splitting one stake across a thousand fake agents buys no extra influence.
